{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the six internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders detected: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any other rows have revenue that looks like 999999.99 but is stored differently
# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any other suspicious high values
high_revenue = sales[sales['revenue_float'] > 100000]
print(f"Number of suspicious high-revenue rows (above $100k): {len(high_revenue)}")

# Check status of these high-revenue rows
print("Status of high-revenue rows:")
print(high_revenue['status'].value_counts())"}
